note: Lake shoreline polygons digitized from the water fill on the 1966 USGS post-dam topo sheets (Nolin Reservoir/Dickeys Mills quad and Bee Spring quad) at summer pool elevation 515ft - real surveyed/photo-revised shoreline, not modeled. Two water color schemes appear on the source sheets (a uniform blue fill over most of the lake, and a lighter cyan photo-revision tint with retained pre-dam contour lines directly over the pool immediately above the dam) - both are detected. Water bodies outside the lake's known footprint (roughly lat 37.26-37.38, lon -86.26 to -86.10) were filtered out. Used to clip the Gaussian channel depth model so contours never extend past the actual lake edge - see core/bathymetry.py.
